spans.s: Relating to gods, caused by or coming from gods, divine, celestial; संस्कृतं नाम दैवी वागन्वाख्याता महर्षिभिः
वः (i. e. विवाहः) One of the eight forms of marriage, that in which the daughter is given away at a sacrifice to the officiating priest; यज्ञस्य ऋत्विजे दैवः
(for the eight forms of marriage see उद्वाह or
A worshipper of god (देवभक्त); दैवान् सर्वे गुणवन्तो भवन्ति
वम् Fate, destiny, luck, fortune; पूर्वजन्म- कृतं कर्म तद्दैवमिति कथ्यते H. दैवमविद्वांसः प्रमाणयन्ति
; विना पुरुषकारेण दैवमत्र न सिध्यति 'God helps those who help themselves'; दैवं निहत्य कुरु पौरुषमात्मशक्त्या
A religious rite or offering, an oblation to gods; उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल कर्तव्यं दैवमाह्निकम्
Parts of the hands sacred to the gods, i. e. the tips of the fingers; cf.
Royal duties; न तु केवलदैवेन प्रजाभावेन रेमिरे
वी A woman married according to the form of marriage called daiva q. v. above.
a. Divine, super-human; दैवी संपद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता

A division of medicine (the medical use of charms, prayers &c.). -Comp. -अत्ययः evil resulting from unusual natural phenomena. -अधीन, -आयत्त a. dependent on fate; दैवायत्तं कुले जन्म मदायत्तं तु पौरुषम्
.-अहोरात्रः a day of the gods i. e. the human year.-इज्य a. sacred to Jupiter (गुरु), -topaz. -उपहत a. illfated, unfortunate; दैवेनोपहतस्य बुद्धिरथवा सर्वा विपर्यस्यति
. -ऊढा a woman married according to the Daiva ritual. ˚ज the son of such a woman; दैवोढाजः सुतश्चैव सप्त सप्त परावरान्
. -कर्मन् n. offering, oblations to gods. -कृत a.
natural. -कोविद्, -चिन्तकः, -ज्ञः an astrologer, a fortune-teller, पुरोहित प्रकुर्वीत दैवज्ञमुदितोदितम्
. -गतिः f. turn or course of fate; मुक्ताजालं चिरपरिचितं त्याजितो दैवगत्या

. -चिन्ता fatalism; astrology. -ज्ञ a. knowing fate or men's destinies. -तन्त्र a. dependent on fate. -दत्त a. innate, natural. -दीपः the eye. -दुर्विपाकः hardness of fortune, adverseness or unpropitiousness of fate, an evil turn of fate;

a voice from heaven. नक्तं निर्गत्य यत्किञ्चिच्छुभाशुभकरं वचः । श्रूयते तद्विदुर्धीरा दैवप्रश्नमुपश्रुतिम् ॥ -युगम् 'a Yuga of the gods' said to consist of 12 divine years, but see Kull. on एतद् द्वादशसाहस्रं देवानां युगमुच्यते

. -योगः a lucky coincidence, fortuitous combination, fortune, chance. (दैवयोगेन, दैवयोगात् fortunately, accidentally.)-रक्षित a. guarded by the gods; अरक्षितं तिष्ठति दैवरक्षितम् Subhāṣ. -लेखकः a fortune-teller, an astrologer. -वशः, -शम् the power of destiny, subjection to fate.
. quoted above. -विद् m. an astrologer.-सभेयम् a variety of sandal-wood red and smelling like a lotus-flower; Kau.
. -हत a. ill-fated; सुरक्षितं दैवहतं विनश्यति Subhāṣ. -हीन a. ill-fated, unfortunate, unlucky.
(At the end of an adj. comp.) Honouring or worshipping as one's deity, as in सूर्यदैवता जनाः -तम् A god, deity, divinity; मृदं गां दैवतं विप्रं घृतं मधु चतुष्पथं प्रदक्षिणानि कुर्वीत
A number of gods, the whole class of gods;
An idol. (The word is said to be m. also, but is rarely used in that gender. Mammata notices it as a fault called अप्रयुक्तत्व; see अप्रयुक्त).
N. of the third Kāṇḍa of Yāskas Nirukta. -Comp. -पतिः N. of Indra. -सरित् f. the Ganges.
दैवतस् [daivatas], ind. By chance, fortunately, luckily.
दैवत्य [daivatya], a. Addressed or sacred to a deity; हुत्वाग्नीन् सूर्य- दैवत्यान् जपेन् मन्त्रान् समाहितः
दैवलः [daivalḥ] लकः [lakḥ], लकः The servant of an evil spirit.
दैवसिक [daivasika], a. Happening in one day; इत्युक्त्वा ब्राह्मणाय दैवसिकामुत्पत्तिं प्रादात्
दैवासुरम् [daivāsuram], The natural enmity subsisting between the gods and the demons.
दैविक [daivika], a. (-की f.) [देव-ठक्] Relating to the gods, divine; अहोरात्रे विभजते सूर्यो मानुषदैविके
